Queen's Recruit#000.src: Mel and Lanu, you'll be in E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.dst: Mel e Lanu, vocês ficam no E{~}.
Queen's Recruit#000.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#001.src: Room W{~}... Now get going. I have a lot of rooms to assign...
Queen's Recruit#001.dst: Quarto W{~}... Agora andem. Tenho muitos quartos pra distribuir...
Queen's Recruit#001.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#004.src: I need to tell you s-

Queen's Recruit#005.src: Tasim is looking to catch up in {p} at [{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#005.dst: Tasim quer pôr o papo em dia em {p}, em [{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#006.src: {u}! Hey! It's lucky I managed to catch you here.
Queen's Recruit#006.dst: {u}! Ei! Que sorte ter te encontrado aqui.
Queen's Recruit#006.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#007.src: It's been a while, hasn't it? We should catch up! You've probably had lots of adventures, right?
Queen's Recruit#007.dst: Faz tempo, né? Temos que pôr o papo em dia! Você deve ter vivido um monte de aventuras, né?
Queen's Recruit#007.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#008.src: But before that... I've got to just find...
Queen's Recruit#008.dst: Mas antes disso... só preciso achar...
Queen's Recruit#008.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#009.src: Huh? What am I- oh, yeah. I'm trying to find Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.dst: Hã? O que eu- ah, é. Estou tentando achar o Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#009.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#010.src: He sent me a letter asking me to join him on some... scouting mission. But I haven't been able to find him.
Queen's Recruit#010.dst: Ele me mandou uma carta pedindo pra ir com ele numa... missão de reconhecimento. Mas não consegui achá-lo.
Queen's Recruit#010.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#011.src: It did take me a while to get here... so maybe he's gone somewhere else by now. Aegis did tell me the mission ended up being called off, so...
Queen's Recruit#011.dst: Demorei um pouco pra chegar aqui... então talvez ele já tenha ido pra outro lugar. O Aegis disse que a missão acabou cancelada, então...
Queen's Recruit#011.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#012.src: But if he's not here, then I should probably stop trying to catch him on the streets, huh? I'll just leave a message for him at the barracks.
Queen's Recruit#012.dst: Mas se ele não está aqui, é melhor eu parar de procurá-lo pelas ruas, né? Vou deixar um recado pra ele no quartel.
Queen's Recruit#012.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#013.src: We can head to the tavern and catch up! Gods, I've missed the Rusty Recruit's drinks... that barkeeper, he says it's the same as anywhere else, but it really isn't! Nowhere else pours it like he does.
Queen's Recruit#013.dst: Podemos ir à taverna pôr o papo em dia! Deuses, que saudade das bebidas do Rusty Recruit... o taverneiro diz que é igual a qualquer lugar, mas não é! Ninguém serve como ele.
Queen's Recruit#013.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#014.src: He... doesn't know about Aledar, does he?
Queen's Recruit#014.dst: Ele... não sabe do Aledar, sabe?

Queen's Recruit#015.src: He just got back. You can't... tell him now. You'll do it later, once he's settled in.
Queen's Recruit#015.dst: Ele acabou de voltar. Você não pode... contar agora. Conte depois, quando ele se ajeitar.

Queen's Recruit#016.src: ...he doesn't know. You have to break the news to him.
Queen's Recruit#016.dst: ...ele não sabe. Você vai ter que dar a notícia a ele.

Queen's Recruit#017.src: Pardon me, excuse me- coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#017.dst: Com licença, perdão- passando! Passando! Ah, vocês dois! Bem quem eu procurava.
Queen's Recruit#017.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#018.src: Pardon me, excuse me coming through! Coming through! Ah, you two! Just the folks I was looking for.
Queen's Recruit#018.dst: Com licença, perdão passando! Passando! Ah, vocês dois! Bem quem eu procurava.
Queen's Recruit#018.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#020.src: Well, perhaps not specifically. I've got a list of folks to try and track down, and the two of you are on it! Tasim and {u}, right?
Queen's Recruit#020.dst: Bom, talvez não especificamente. Tenho uma lista de gente pra encontrar, e vocês dois estão nela! Tasim e {u}, certo?
Queen's Recruit#020.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#021.src: I've got an important missive from {p}. Direct from the King himself, yep yep!
Queen's Recruit#021.dst: Trago uma mensagem importante de {p}. Direto do próprio Rei, isso, isso!
Queen's Recruit#021.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#022.src: Really? I don't think I've even seen him since... what could he possibly want us for?
Queen's Recruit#022.dst: Sério? Acho que nem o vejo desde... o que ele poderia querer com a gente?
Queen's Recruit#022.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#023.src: I'm not privy to the details, I'm afraid! He's summoning a number of you seasoned adventurers to the castle, for some sort of meeting.
Queen's Recruit#023.dst: Não sei dos detalhes, receio! Ele está convocando vários aventureiros experientes ao castelo, pra uma espécie de reunião.
Queen's Recruit#023.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#024.src: Anyway, I've got more to try and track down, so I'll give you the written letters and be on my way! Best of luck with whatever it is!
Queen's Recruit#024.dst: Enfim, ainda tenho mais gente pra encontrar, então entrego as cartas e sigo caminho! Boa sorte com o que quer que seja!
Queen's Recruit#024.speaker: Ragni Courier

Queen's Recruit#026.src: Hm. That is strange, isn't it? I guess we'll have to call off drinks till later... probably for the best. Maybe I'll be able to catch him before...
Queen's Recruit#026.dst: Hm. Que estranho, né? Acho que vamos ter que deixar as bebidas pra depois... talvez seja melhor. Talvez eu consiga achá-lo antes de...
Queen's Recruit#026.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#027.src: Oh, uh- you go on ahead. I have to stop by the barracks first. I'll meet you in {p}, then?
Queen's Recruit#027.dst: Ah, hã- vá na frente. Preciso passar no quartel antes. Te encontro em {p}, então?
Queen's Recruit#027.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#028.src: I'll meet you in {p}. I have to deal with some things at the barracks first.
Queen's Recruit#028.dst: Te encontro em {p}. Preciso resolver umas coisas no quartel antes.
Queen's Recruit#028.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#029.src: Attend the meeting with the King in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#029.dst: Vá à reunião com o Rei em {p}, em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#030.src: ...oh, there you are. Didn't you head out before me?
Queen's Recruit#030.dst: ...ah, aí está você. Não tinha saído antes de mim?
Queen's Recruit#030.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#031.src: I don't know most of the people here, so I'll stick with you for now.
Queen's Recruit#031.dst: Não conheço quase ninguém aqui, então vou ficar com você por enquanto.
Queen's Recruit#031.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#032.src: ...and it's all crashing down, right? So I knock the zombie back, grab the kid, and jump for-
Queen's Recruit#032.dst: ...e está tudo desabando, né? Aí eu empurro o zumbi, pego o garoto e pulo pra-
Queen's Recruit#032.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#033.src: Wait, wait wait wait - you're tellin' me there was a kid involved? And you still set off the bombs?!
Queen's Recruit#033.dst: Espera, espera espera espera - tinha um garoto no meio? E mesmo assim cê detonou as bombas?!
Queen's Recruit#033.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#034.src: Yeah! I said that already, right? That was the whole reason I-
Queen's Recruit#034.dst: É! Eu já disse isso, né? Foi justamente por isso que eu-
Queen's Recruit#034.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#035.src: Ahem. Pause the story for a bit, Linton. We have company.
Queen's Recruit#035.dst: Aham. Pausa a história um pouco, Linton. Temos companhia.
Queen's Recruit#035.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#036.src: Well, if it ain't {u}! It's good to see someone else familiar 'round here.
Queen's Recruit#036.dst: Ora, se não é {u}! Bom ver outra cara conhecida por aqui.
Queen's Recruit#036.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#037.dst: Quê, e eu não sou conhecido?
Queen's Recruit#037.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#038.src: I do try to keep my distance.
Queen's Recruit#038.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#039.src: So, you received the summons too? The King has a lot of people here. It's interesting.
Queen's Recruit#039.dst: Então vocês também receberam a convocação? O Rei chamou muita gente. Interessante.
Queen's Recruit#039.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#040.src: We did, yes. And it sounded like they had even more people on that list that they were searching for.
Queen's Recruit#040.dst: Recebemos, sim. E parecia que eles procuravam ainda mais gente daquela lista.
Queen's Recruit#040.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#041.src: Oh, apologies, I hadn't noticed you there. You're a friend of {u}'s, I take it?
Queen's Recruit#041.dst: Ah, perdão, não tinha te visto aí. Você é amigo de {u}, imagino?
Queen's Recruit#041.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#042.src: I am! We arrived in Wynn on the same caravan. I'm Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.dst: Sou! Chegamos a Wynn na mesma caravana. Sou o Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#042.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#044.src: So you're the one Aledar was always talking about! I thought you were off in Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.dst: Então você é de quem o Aledar vivia falando! Achei que estivesse em Gavel?
Queen's Recruit#044.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#045.src: I... was. How do you all know him?
Queen's Recruit#045.dst: Eu... estava. Como vocês o conhecem?
Queen's Recruit#045.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#046.src: I believe we first met on a mission to reclaim {p}'s barracks from a treasonous commander. We've run into each other a few times since.
Queen's Recruit#046.dst: Acho que nos conhecemos numa missão para retomar o quartel de {p} de um comandante traidor. Nos esbarramos algumas vezes desde então.
Queen's Recruit#046.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#047.src: Still, it's good to finally get t' meet you! We've heard lots of stories! Including somethin' about not respondin' to letters...?
Queen's Recruit#047.dst: Mesmo assim, bom finalmente te conhecer! Ouvimos um monte de histórias! Incluindo algo sobre não responder cartas...?
Queen's Recruit#047.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#048.src: Oh... right. We, uh... sorted that out.
Queen's Recruit#048.dst: Ah... é. Nós, hã... resolvemos isso.
Queen's Recruit#048.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#049.src: But speaking of- have any of you seen him recently?
Queen's Recruit#049.dst: Mas falando nisso- algum de vocês o viu recentemente?
Queen's Recruit#049.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#050.src: 'fraid not. I don't think our paths've crossed since... was it the siege at {p}? Must've been.
Queen's Recruit#050.dst: Receio que não. Acho que a gente não se cruza desde... foi o cerco de {p}? Deve ter sido.
Queen's Recruit#050.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#051.src: I saw him a month ago in {p}! I asked him what he was working on and if I could help and he just brushed me off. Weird, right?
Queen's Recruit#051.dst: Eu o vi há um mês em {p}! Perguntei no que ele estava trabalhando e se podia ajudar, e ele só me dispensou. Estranho, né?
Queen's Recruit#051.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#052.src: Mmn. No, that sounds like him. I think he had enough of your antics last time.
Queen's Recruit#052.dst: Mmn. Não, é bem a cara dele. Acho que ele cansou das suas palhaçadas da última vez.
Queen's Recruit#052.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#053.src: What?! I'm capable. C'mon, Mel, tell her I'm capable.
Queen's Recruit#053.dst: Quê?! Eu sou capaz. Vai, Mel, diz pra ela que sou capaz.
Queen's Recruit#053.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#054.src: Linton, y'were just tellin' us about how you caved in a whole temple by-
Queen's Recruit#054.dst: Linton, cê tava contando agorinha como fez um templo inteiro desabar ao-
Queen's Recruit#054.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#055.src: Okay! Okay, okay okay, let's talk about literally anything else! Tasim, right? What's... uh...
Queen's Recruit#055.dst: Tá! Tá, tá tá, vamos falar de literalmente qualquer outra coisa! Tasim, né? Qual... hã...
Queen's Recruit#055.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#056.src: ...so, your... no, no, give me a moment- you were... and... um... oh, right...
Queen's Recruit#056.dst: ...então, seu... não, não, me dá um momento- você estava... e... hum... ah, é...
Queen's Recruit#056.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#059.src: Linton!! Y'can't just ask someone that!!
Queen's Recruit#059.dst: Linton!! Não se pergunta isso assim!!
Queen's Recruit#059.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#061.src: It was nice meeting you, Tasim. I look forward to working with you during this mission.
Queen's Recruit#061.dst: Foi um prazer te conhecer, Tasim. Espero trabalhar com você nesta missão.
Queen's Recruit#061.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#062.src: ...likewise. It's always nice meeting friends of Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#062.dst: ...igualmente. É sempre bom conhecer amigos do Aledar.
Queen's Recruit#062.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#063.src: Well, look at you! It's been quite a time since we last spoke. Far above the task of cleaning out sewers now, eh?
Queen's Recruit#063.dst: Ora, olha só você! Faz tempo que não conversamos. Bem acima de limpar esgotos agora, hein?
Queen's Recruit#063.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#064.src: I've heard some tell of your accomplishments. Fine work, fine work.
Queen's Recruit#064.dst: Ouvi falar das suas façanhas. Belo trabalho, belo trabalho.
Queen's Recruit#064.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#065.src: And... hm. Aren't you the one who ran off to Gavel without sayin' a word? Didn't expect you to be one o' the ones picked out for this.
Queen's Recruit#065.dst: E... hm. Não foi você que fugiu pra Gavel sem dizer uma palavra? Não esperava que fosse um dos escolhidos pra isso.
Queen's Recruit#065.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#066.src: I... didn't expect it either. I didn't even realize the King still remembered me, truth be told.
Queen's Recruit#066.dst: Eu... também não esperava. Pra falar a verdade, nem sabia que o Rei ainda se lembrava de mim.
Queen's Recruit#066.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#067.src: Mmn. Well, whatever the reason, you're here now. Don't suppose it matters much the path you took to get here. We need all the folks we can get- or so Kymer's been sayin'.
Queen's Recruit#067.dst: Mmn. Bom, seja qual for o motivo, você está aqui agora. Acho que pouco importa o caminho que te trouxe. Precisamos de toda a gente possível- ou é o que o Kymer anda dizendo.
Queen's Recruit#067.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#068.src: Well well! If my eyes don't deceive me! {u} and Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.dst: Ora, ora! Se meus olhos não me enganam! {u} e Tasim!
Queen's Recruit#068.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#069.src: I'll say, I didn't quite expect them to track you down! What with your... extended stint off in Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.dst: Devo dizer que não esperava que os encontrassem! Com essa... longa temporada de vocês em Gavel.
Queen's Recruit#069.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#070.src: I should say the same about you, captain. Did {p} no longer have a use for you once the war ended?
Queen's Recruit#070.dst: Digo o mesmo do senhor, capitão. {p} não precisava mais do senhor depois que a guerra acabou?
Queen's Recruit#070.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#071.src: Ah... nothing of the sort. You know, I was sent out there initially to serve as more of an envoy from {p}! If the King needs a diplomatic situation sorted, I'm the one he turns to first.
Queen's Recruit#071.dst: Ah... nada disso. Sabe, fui mandado pra lá inicialmente mais como um enviado de {p}! Se o Rei precisa resolver uma situação diplomática, sou o primeiro a quem ele recorre.
Queen's Recruit#071.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#072.src: Which... is indeed why I am here now. I was recalled rather abruptly several weeks ago. It seems we've encountered a tricky situation with our... neighboring province.
Queen's Recruit#072.dst: O que... é justamente por que estou aqui. Fui chamado de volta às pressas há algumas semanas. Parece que temos uma situação delicada com nossa... província vizinha.
Queen's Recruit#072.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#073.src: But! I shan't say more before the King arrives. He'll tell you all of the problem that hopefully we will be able to resolve.
Queen's Recruit#073.dst: Mas! Não direi mais nada antes de o Rei chegar. Ele vai contar a vocês o problema que, com sorte, poderemos resolver.
Queen's Recruit#073.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#074.src: ...I see. We'll leave you to it, then.
Queen's Recruit#074.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#075.src: If we align the manaflow with Water, then nudge it to the side, maybe... ah- Reynauld, pass me my notes on... damn, what was it- oh, yes, the recovery period! Pass me those ones.
Queen's Recruit#075.dst: Se alinharmos o fluxo de mana com Água e o desviarmos um pouco, talvez... ah- Reynauld, me passe as notas sobre... droga, o que era- ah, sim, o período de recuperação! Me passe essas.
Queen's Recruit#075.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#076.src: ...You already have them on your left, doctor.
Queen's Recruit#076.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#077.src: Do I now! It seems I do... oh, but this is only the first half- where did I leave the rest...
Queen's Recruit#077.dst: Estão mesmo! Parece que sim... ah, mas esta é só a primeira metade- onde deixei o resto...
Queen's Recruit#077.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#078.src: Sigh... If you'd just allow me to organize for you, maybe you wouldn't-
Queen's Recruit#078.dst: Ai... Se o senhor me deixasse organizar tudo, talvez não-
Queen's Recruit#078.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#079.src: And ruin my predefined sorting system?! No, Reynauld, I do think it works perfectly well as it is, thank you very much! Now, where could it have-
Queen's Recruit#079.dst: E arruinar meu sistema de organização predefinido?! Não, Reynauld, acho que funciona perfeitamente bem assim, muito obrigado! Agora, onde será que-
Queen's Recruit#079.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#080.src: Ah! You two! Good, good, you're here- I was worried Reynauld would be the only other one with recovered memories around here!
Queen's Recruit#080.dst: Ah! Vocês dois! Ótimo, ótimo, vocês estão aqui- temia que o Reynauld fosse o único outro por aqui com memórias recuperadas!
Queen's Recruit#080.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#081.src: What, you didn't test it on anyone else after we left?
Queen's Recruit#081.dst: Quê, não testou em mais ninguém depois que saímos?
Queen's Recruit#081.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#082.src: Test it on- no, of course not! After what I saw? No, no, that would certainly not have been worth the risk. No new test subjects until I am certain it's flawless!
Queen's Recruit#082.dst: Testar em- não, claro que não! Depois do que eu vi? Não, não, certamente não valeria o risco. Nenhuma cobaia nova até eu ter certeza de que é perfeito!
Queen's Recruit#082.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#083.src: I've been using it on myself instead! And, let me tell you- the breakthroughs I have made... there is much to be learned.
Queen's Recruit#083.dst: Em vez disso, venho usando em mim mesmo! E, deixem-me dizer- os avanços que consegui... há muito a aprender.
Queen's Recruit#083.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#085.src: Pah! "Safety" - a meaningless term made only to stifle progress. Have there been side effects - certainly! But it has all been worth it.
Queen's Recruit#085.dst: Pah! "Segurança" - um termo vazio feito só pra sufocar o progresso. Houve efeitos colaterais? Com certeza! Mas valeu muito a pena.
Queen's Recruit#085.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#086.src: Now, I must return to the pages... I've some equations I need to perfect before the King arrives...
Queen's Recruit#086.dst: Agora, preciso voltar às páginas... Tenho umas equações a aperfeiçoar antes de o Rei chegar...
Queen's Recruit#086.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#087.src: Hm. I can't say I would have expected you to be here, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.dst: Hm. Não posso dizer que esperava te ver aqui, Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#087.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#088.src: Well... fate has other plans, I guess. How about you? Did you stay in {p}?
Queen's Recruit#088.dst: Bom... o destino tem outros planos, acho. E você? Ficou em {p}?
Queen's Recruit#088.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#089.src: Mostly. Moved around for a few assignments here and there, but I kept coming back.
Queen's Recruit#089.dst: Quase sempre. Me mudei por umas missões aqui e ali, mas sempre voltava.
Queen's Recruit#089.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#090.src: ...we haven't spoken in a while. Are you... doing well? How have you been managing the memories?
Queen's Recruit#090.dst: ...faz tempo que não conversamos. Você está... bem? Como tem lidado com as memórias?
Queen's Recruit#090.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#091.src: As well as I could be expected to, I guess. It was rough for the first few months. Eventually, I got used to it.
Queen's Recruit#091.dst: Tão bem quanto se poderia esperar, acho. Os primeiros meses foram difíceis. Com o tempo, me acostumei.
Queen's Recruit#091.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#092.src: How about you? I also wouldn't have expected you to show for a mission like this.
Queen's Recruit#092.dst: E você? Também não esperava que aparecesse numa missão dessas.
Queen's Recruit#092.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#093.src: Same as you. Helped that Caid and I managed to talk it through. We meet every so often, talk about it. He talks about his sister, how he wants to find her one day.
Queen's Recruit#093.dst: Igual a você. Ajudou o Caid e eu termos conversado sobre isso. Nos vemos de vez em quando, falamos disso. Ele fala da irmã, de como quer encontrá-la um dia.
Queen's Recruit#093.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#094.dst: Isso é... bom. Fico feliz por você.
Queen's Recruit#094.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#095.src: Hm. Nothing stopping you from stopping by, yourself. It might even help you.
Queen's Recruit#095.dst: Hm. Nada te impede de aparecer também. Pode até te ajudar.
Queen's Recruit#095.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#096.src: I'll... consider it. Good to see you again, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.dst: Vou... pensar nisso. Bom te ver de novo, Reynauld.
Queen's Recruit#096.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#097.src: Another soldier? Allow me to see your summons.
Queen's Recruit#097.dst: Outro soldado? Permita-me ver sua convocação.
Queen's Recruit#097.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#098.src: ...good. Come on in, {u}. The King will be arriving shortly.
Queen's Recruit#098.dst: ...certo. Pode entrar, {u}. O Rei chegará em breve.
Queen's Recruit#098.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#100.src: If you insist. Don't take too long.
Queen's Recruit#100.speaker: Ragni Guard

Queen's Recruit#101.src: Ah... here we are. I thank you all for coming on such short notice. It has been some time since I have seen many of you.
Queen's Recruit#101.dst: Ah... aqui estamos. Agradeço a todos por virem tão em cima da hora. Faz algum tempo que não vejo muitos de vocês.
Queen's Recruit#101.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#102.src: ...I'll get right to the point. We find ourselves in a very delicate position when it comes to our relations with our neighboring province, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#102.dst: ...Vou direto ao ponto. Estamos numa posição muito delicada no que diz respeito às relações com nossa província vizinha, Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#102.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#105.src: Good. I guess that makes two of us.

Queen's Recruit#106.src: It sounds very suspicious. Why the sudden interest? Why now?
Queen's Recruit#106.dst: Muito suspeito. Por que esse interesse repentino? Por que agora?

Queen's Recruit#107.src: We rely heavily on the flow of new recruits sent to us, but we have no means of contacting their province. Only they may reach out to us, and only once before have they chosen to do so.
Queen's Recruit#107.dst: Dependemos muito do fluxo de recrutas que nos enviam, mas não temos como contatar a província deles. Só eles podem nos procurar, e só uma vez antes decidiram fazê-lo.
Queen's Recruit#107.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#108.src: ...several weeks ago, we received a cloaked visitor through the outskirts. She claimed to be of Fruma, one of their Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#108.dst: ...há algumas semanas, recebemos uma visitante encapuzada pelos arredores. Ela disse ser de Fruma, uma de suas Soberanas.
Queen's Recruit#108.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#109.src: We were extended an invitation, of sorts. Of all the recruits we have ever received, we were to select the greatest, and send them into Fruma for some sort of celebration.
Queen's Recruit#109.dst: Recebemos uma espécie de convite. De todos os recrutas que já recebemos, devíamos escolher os melhores e enviá-los a Fruma para uma espécie de celebração.
Queen's Recruit#109.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#110.src: Is that who we are? The greatest?
Queen's Recruit#110.dst: É isso que somos? Os melhores?
Queen's Recruit#110.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#111.src: The ones that could be reached, at the very least! Perhaps some were greater yet, but we all know the roaming habits of your sort, and tracking them down really can prove-
Queen's Recruit#111.dst: Os que deu pra encontrar, pelo menos! Talvez houvesse melhores, mas todos conhecemos o hábito errante de vocês, e rastreá-los pode ser-
Queen's Recruit#111.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#112.src: Ugh, we're not just going along with this, are we?
Queen's Recruit#112.dst: Argh, não vamos simplesmente aceitar isso, vamos?
Queen's Recruit#112.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#114.src: What? They're demanding something weird and obviously suspicious, so why should we just accept it?
Queen's Recruit#114.dst: Quê? Eles exigem algo estranho e obviamente suspeito, então por que a gente aceitaria assim?
Queen's Recruit#114.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#115.src: I'm afraid we don't have a choice in the matter. As I mentioned, the recruits we receive make all the difference in our province's continued survival. If we were to reject this invitation...
Queen's Recruit#115.dst: Receio que não temos escolha. Como mencionei, os recrutas que recebemos fazem toda a diferença na sobrevivência da nossa província. Se recusássemos este convite...
Queen's Recruit#115.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#116.src: ...who's to say they wouldn't just stop sendin' 'em, eh? Tough.
Queen's Recruit#116.dst: ...quem garante que não parariam de mandar eles, né? Complicado.
Queen's Recruit#116.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#117.src: Besides all that, think of the opportunity this presents! A true, freely-given view of what lies beyond those walls! We'd be fools not to accept it, no matter the implied threat!
Queen's Recruit#117.dst: Além disso, pensem na oportunidade! Uma visão verdadeira e espontânea do que há além daquelas muralhas! Seríamos tolos de recusar, seja qual for a ameaça implícita!
Queen's Recruit#117.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#118.src: Indeed. I regret that I must request this of you... but there is no other choice. You must accept this invitation.
Queen's Recruit#118.dst: De fato. Lamento ter de pedir isso a vocês... mas não há outra escolha. Vocês devem aceitar este convite.
Queen's Recruit#118.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#119.src: ...even those of us with bad experiences with the province?
Queen's Recruit#119.dst: ...até os que tiveram más experiências com a província?
Queen's Recruit#119.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#120.src: I apologize... but you must. My hands are tied.
Queen's Recruit#120.dst: Peço desculpas... mas deve. Estou de mãos atadas.
Queen's Recruit#120.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#121.src: I take it we are expected to gather as much intelligence on Fruma as we can while we're in there?
Queen's Recruit#121.dst: Imagino que se espera que coletemos o máximo de informações sobre Fruma enquanto estivermos lá?
Queen's Recruit#121.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#122.src: That is the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#122.dst: Esse é o plano, de fato! Explico mais quando chegarmos, mas creio que temos um prazo, correto?
Queen's Recruit#122.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#123.src: That's the plan, indeed! I'll explain more once we're there, but I believe we're on a time limit, correct?
Queen's Recruit#123.dst: É esse o plano, de fato! Explico mais quando chegarmos, mas creio que temos um prazo, correto?
Queen's Recruit#123.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#124.src: You are correct, doctor. I have been told that a representative will greet you all at the royal gates of Fruma, situated on the western coast.
Queen's Recruit#124.dst: Correto, doutor. Disseram-me que um representante os receberá nos portões reais de Fruma, na costa oeste.
Queen's Recruit#124.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#125.src: I've sent a courier ahead to {p} to inform the local captains of the destination they are to take you to.
Queen's Recruit#125.dst: Enviei um mensageiro na frente a {p} para informar os capitães locais do destino para onde devem levá-los.
Queen's Recruit#125.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#126.src: {p}... I know a captain there. {u}, want to join me?
Queen's Recruit#126.dst: {p}... Conheço um capitão lá. {u}, quer vir comigo?
Queen's Recruit#126.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#127.src: Finally... a glimpse at the province's inner workings... how long have I been seeking these answers?
Queen's Recruit#127.dst: Enfim... um vislumbre do funcionamento interno da província... há quanto tempo busco essas respostas?
Queen's Recruit#127.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#128.src: So many theories... how many will be proven right? How many will be wrong? I cannot wait to find out!
Queen's Recruit#128.dst: Tantas teorias... quantas se provarão certas? Quantas estarão erradas? Mal posso esperar para descobrir!
Queen's Recruit#128.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#129.src: Sigh... I did know this was coming. Why else would the doctor have been summoned? But I hoped I was wrong.
Queen's Recruit#129.dst: Ai... eu sabia que isso vinha. Por que mais chamariam o doutor? Mas eu torcia pra estar errado.
Queen's Recruit#129.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#130.src: Tough situation, isn't it? Lots o' secrecy on part of the Frumans...
Queen's Recruit#130.dst: Situação difícil, né? Muito segredo da parte dos frumanos...
Queen's Recruit#130.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#131.src: But we'll handle it. Everyone here's plenty capable, after all.
Queen's Recruit#131.dst: Mas a gente dá conta. Todo mundo aqui é bem capaz, afinal.
Queen's Recruit#131.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#132.src: Hm... what a situation it is we find ourselves in! Diplomacy is my specialty, of course, but my expertise has not prepared me for... this.
Queen's Recruit#132.dst: Hm... que situação a nossa! Diplomacia é minha especialidade, claro, mas minha experiência não me preparou para... isto.
Queen's Recruit#132.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#133.src: Fruma knows what they want, and know they are strong enough that they can afford not to let up their position.
Queen's Recruit#133.dst: Fruma sabe o que quer, e sabe que é forte o bastante para se dar ao luxo de não ceder.
Queen's Recruit#133.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#134.src: Another top secret mission already? And I'm not even allowed to bring my explosives?
Queen's Recruit#134.dst: Outra missão ultrassecreta já? E nem posso levar meus explosivos?
Queen's Recruit#134.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#135.src: It's interesting, at least! Way better than that last assignment...
Queen's Recruit#135.dst: Pelo menos é interessante! Bem melhor que aquela última tarefa...
Queen's Recruit#135.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#136.src: This mission's a big deal, huh? Lots o' strong folks recalled for it, at least.
Queen's Recruit#136.dst: Essa missão é coisa séria, hein? Chamaram muita gente forte pra ela, pelo menos.
Queen's Recruit#136.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#137.src: Makes me a bit nervous, honestly!
Queen's Recruit#137.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#138.src: Fruma... I can't say it's been on my mind much. It's a mystery, yes, but not one with any available answers.
Queen's Recruit#138.dst: Fruma... não posso dizer que pensei muito nela. É um mistério, sim, mas sem respostas disponíveis.
Queen's Recruit#138.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#139.src: Well, until now, I suppose. I'll have to prepare a list of details to look out for...
Queen's Recruit#139.dst: Bom, até agora, imagino. Vou ter que preparar uma lista de detalhes a observar...
Queen's Recruit#139.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#140.src: And yet again, I must send you all into danger... a different sort, this time around, but danger nonetheless.
Queen's Recruit#140.dst: E mais uma vez preciso mandar todos vocês ao perigo... de outro tipo, desta vez, mas perigo mesmo assim.
Queen's Recruit#140.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#141.src: I remember each face which passes through my castle. I rarely see any of them again.
Queen's Recruit#141.dst: Lembro de cada rosto que passa pelo meu castelo. Raramente volto a ver algum deles.
Queen's Recruit#141.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#142.src: But this time... I have faith we will meet once more. Go on, young hero. Your mission lies ahead of you.
Queen's Recruit#142.dst: Mas desta vez... tenho fé de que nos veremos de novo. Vá, jovem herói. Sua missão o aguarda.
Queen's Recruit#142.speaker: King of Ragni

Queen's Recruit#143.src: ...back to Fruma. I've only just come back to Wynn, and now...
Queen's Recruit#143.dst: ...de volta a Fruma. Acabei de voltar a Wynn, e agora...
Queen's Recruit#143.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#144.src: But it had to happen eventually. And I do want answers. So... in we go.
Queen's Recruit#144.dst: Mas isso tinha que acontecer. E eu quero respostas. Então... lá vamos nós.
Queen's Recruit#144.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#145.src: I'll be heading to the {p} Seaskipper, if you want to tag along.
Queen's Recruit#145.dst: Vou até o Seaskipper de {p}, se quiser vir junto.
Queen's Recruit#145.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#146.src: Travel to the Gate of Fruma at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or meet up with Tasim in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#146.dst: Viaje até o Portão de Fruma em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] ou encontre Tasim em {p}.

Queen's Recruit#147.src: ...Oh! You're here! Lost in thought, sorry.
Queen's Recruit#147.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#148.src: It's all a little surreal, isn't it? I only just got back to Wynn, and now... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.dst: É tudo meio surreal, né? Acabei de voltar a Wynn, e agora... Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#148.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#149.src: Kind of makes me wish we had Aledar here too. The three of us on an adventure again! Going back... home...
Queen's Recruit#149.dst: Me faz querer que o Aledar estivesse aqui também. Nós três numa aventura de novo! Voltando... pra casa...
Queen's Recruit#149.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#150.src: I guess we'll just have to tell him all about it when we get back. He'll be sad he missed it, I bet.
Queen's Recruit#150.dst: Acho que vamos ter que contar tudo a ele quando voltarmos. Aposto que vai ficar triste de ter perdido.
Queen's Recruit#150.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#152.src: Oi, there! Are those my two favorite customers I see?
Queen's Recruit#152.dst: Ô, vocês aí! São meus dois clientes favoritos ali?
Queen's Recruit#152.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#153.src: You call everyone your favorite customer, captain! Don't think I didn't notice!
Queen's Recruit#153.dst: O senhor chama todo mundo de cliente favorito, capitão! Não pense que não notei!
Queen's Recruit#153.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#154.src: Eheheheh, well, it's true, ain't it? I got lots o' favorites! Ah, anyhow, you're here for a trip, ain't'cha?
Queen's Recruit#154.dst: Ehehehe, bom, é verdade, não é? Tenho um monte de favoritos! Ah, enfim, cês vieram fazer uma viagem, né?
Queen's Recruit#154.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#155.src: We are! You've... probably heard the details already? There should have been something about a new destination.
Queen's Recruit#155.dst: Viemos! O senhor... provavelmente já sabe dos detalhes? Deve ter chegado algo sobre um destino novo.
Queen's Recruit#155.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#156.src: Aye. That I have. Some scrawny {p} courier wooshed past earlier! I barely got a word in before he was off again! Real interesting fellow.
Queen's Recruit#156.dst: Sei, sim. Um mensageiro magricela de {p} passou voando mais cedo! Mal deu pra dizer uma palavra antes de ele sumir de novo! Sujeito curioso.
Queen's Recruit#156.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#157.src: ... Not a part o' the sea I like to visit, but I reckon I can make an exception this time.
Queen's Recruit#157.dst: ... Não é uma parte do mar que eu goste de visitar, mas dá pra abrir uma exceção desta vez.
Queen's Recruit#157.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#158.src: Hm... I can pay you extra for the trip, if you'd like.
Queen's Recruit#158.dst: Hm... posso pagar a mais pela viagem, se quiser.
Queen's Recruit#158.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#159.src: Ha! No, no, there's no need for that. It's free of charge for my two favorite customers, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#159.dst: Ha! Não, não, não precisa. É de graça pros meus dois clientes favoritos, ehehe!
Queen's Recruit#159.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#160.src: ...and, 'course, s'all paid for from {p}'s royal coffers anyhow. Now, hop aboard 'fore I change my mind and leave without ya!
Queen's Recruit#160.dst: ...e, claro, tá tudo pago pelos cofres reais de {p} mesmo. Agora, subam a bordo antes que eu mude de ideia e parta sem vocês!
Queen's Recruit#160.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#162.src: ...so, Fruma, eh? I'd ask what business ya've got there, but... figure it's top secret.
Queen's Recruit#162.dst: ...então, Fruma, é? Eu perguntaria o que cês vão fazer lá, mas... deve ser ultrassecreto.
Queen's Recruit#162.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#163.src: We've been... invited into the province. Supposedly, it's for some sort of celebration, but...
Queen's Recruit#163.dst: Fomos... convidados à província. Supostamente, é pra uma espécie de celebração, mas...
Queen's Recruit#163.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#164.src: Mmn. Aye, knowin' the rumors... not the kind o' place to just invite folks in, is it?
Queen's Recruit#164.dst: Mmn. É, conhecendo os boatos... não é o tipo de lugar que convida gente assim, né?
Queen's Recruit#164.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#166.src: Tell me, what's on yer mind then? The both o' you. Speakin' thoughts out tends to make 'em easier to manage, in my experience.
Queen's Recruit#166.dst: Me diz, o que tá na cabeça de vocês? Dos dois. Na minha experiência, falar em voz alta ajuda a lidar com as coisas.
Queen's Recruit#166.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#167.src: Fruma went through all that trouble to erase our memories, to get rid of us... just to ask for us back out of nowhere.
Queen's Recruit#167.dst: Fruma se deu ao trabalho de apagar nossas memórias, de se livrar de nós... só pra nos pedir de volta do nada.
Queen's Recruit#167.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#168.src: I don't know why they're doing it, but I'm worried there's more going on.
Queen's Recruit#168.dst: Não sei por que estão fazendo isso, mas tenho medo de que haja algo mais.
Queen's Recruit#168.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#169.src: I've not got more of a clue than either o' you, but I reckon that suspicion is warranted.
Queen's Recruit#169.dst: Não sei mais que vocês, mas acho que essa desconfiança tem fundamento.
Queen's Recruit#169.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#170.src: But don't let it consume you, aye? Some suspicion is healthy, but if it colors everything ya do, it'll hurt ya just as bad as naivety would. Keep an open mind.
Queen's Recruit#170.dst: Mas não deixe isso te consumir, tá? Um pouco de desconfiança é saudável, mas se tingir tudo que você faz, vai te ferir tanto quanto a ingenuidade. Mente aberta.
Queen's Recruit#170.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#171.src: ...it's possible. I hope you're right, and it is all fine, and we are all overthinking it...
Queen's Recruit#171.dst: ...é possível. Tomara que tenha razão, que esteja tudo bem e que estejamos exagerando...
Queen's Recruit#171.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#172.src: But I can't let my guard down. Everything about this situation is screaming that something isn't right, and... I don't know what.
Queen's Recruit#172.dst: Mas não posso baixar a guarda. Tudo nessa situação grita que algo está errado, e... não sei o quê.
Queen's Recruit#172.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#173.src: Nothin' wrong with hopin' for the best. Stayin' positive is all ya can really do, sometimes.
Queen's Recruit#173.dst: Nada de errado em torcer pelo melhor. Manter o otimismo é tudo que dá pra fazer, às vezes.
Queen's Recruit#173.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#174.src: Out here on the sea, we have a saying... go searchin' for the storm, and it'll find ya itself. Don't expect the worst, or it'll find a way to come to pass.
Queen's Recruit#174.dst: Aqui no mar temos um ditado... vá atrás da tempestade e ela mesma te encontra. Não espere o pior, ou ele dá um jeito de acontecer.
Queen's Recruit#174.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#176.src: ...home? Home. I guess. It'll be nice to have more memories of it than just... you know. Curses, and all that.
Queen's Recruit#176.dst: ...lar? Lar. Acho que sim. Vai ser bom ter mais lembranças de lá do que só... sabe. Maldições e tal.
Queen's Recruit#176.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#177.src: Linton and Kymer are in W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.dst: Linton e Kymer ficam no W{~}.
Queen's Recruit#177.speaker: Representative

similar.text: Linton and Kymer are in W2.

Queen's Recruit#178.src: Hm. I don’t got much of a home to get back to, either. Had it taken from me by those I trusted, eheh!
Queen's Recruit#178.dst: Hm. Eu também não tenho muito lar pra onde voltar. Me tomaram por gente em quem eu confiava, ehehe!
Queen's Recruit#178.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#179.src: ... But, I made my own home, out here on the sea. Think even if I could go back now, I wouldn’t!
Queen's Recruit#179.dst: ... Mas fiz meu próprio lar, aqui no mar. Acho que mesmo se pudesse voltar agora, não voltaria!
Queen's Recruit#179.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#180.src: So, if y’don’t like what ya find... don’t feel forced to take it, y’hear?
Queen's Recruit#180.dst: Então, se não gostar do que achar... não se sinta obrigado a aceitar, ouviu?
Queen's Recruit#180.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#181.src: ...I'll keep that in mind. Thank you, captain.
Queen's Recruit#181.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#182.src: Ah, it's what I'm here for, ain't it? Givin' sage advice and sailin' folks around the sea!
Queen's Recruit#182.dst: Ah, é pra isso que tô aqui, não é? Dar conselhos sábios e levar gente pelo mar!
Queen's Recruit#182.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#183.src: And look at that, on the horizon! Shinin' opulent docks... seems we've arrived.
Queen's Recruit#183.dst: E olha só, no horizonte! Docas opulentas e reluzentes... parece que chegamos.
Queen's Recruit#183.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#184.src: Dunno what you'll be facin' in there... but good luck anyway, aye?
Queen's Recruit#184.dst: Não sei o que cês vão enfrentar lá... mas boa sorte mesmo assim, tá?
Queen's Recruit#184.speaker: Seaskipper Captain

Queen's Recruit#185.src: We'll need it. Thanks for bringing us here, captain.
Queen's Recruit#185.dst: Vamos precisar. Obrigado por nos trazer, capitão.
Queen's Recruit#185.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#186.src: It's... impressive. To build something like this for a gate no one ever uses...
Queen's Recruit#186.dst: É... impressionante. Construir algo assim pra um portão que ninguém usa...
Queen's Recruit#186.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#187.src: I guess they have the resources to spare.
Queen's Recruit#187.dst: Acho que eles têm recursos de sobra.
Queen's Recruit#187.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#188.src: Meet up with the group at the gate at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Queen's Recruit#188.dst: Encontre o grupo no portão em [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Queen's Recruit#189.src: Finally! The stragglers arrive. You certainly took your time, didn't you?
Queen's Recruit#189.dst: Finalmente! Chegam os retardatários. Vocês não tiveram pressa nenhuma, hein?
Queen's Recruit#189.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#190.src: Not the time, Kymer. Leave the poor man be for an hour, eh? Got bigger fish to fry, n' all that.
Queen's Recruit#190.dst: Não é hora, Kymer. Deixa o coitado em paz por uma hora, tá? Temos coisa maior pra resolver.
Queen's Recruit#190.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#191.src: Yes, yes, fine. We've not been able to get a word out of any of these soldiers! Do we even have the right time and place?
Queen's Recruit#191.dst: Sim, sim, tudo bem. Não arrancamos uma palavra de nenhum desses soldados! Será que estamos no lugar e na hora certos?
Queen's Recruit#191.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#192.src: Nah, you just haven't been trying hard enough. Hey, tin can! This is Fruma, right?
Queen's Recruit#192.dst: Nah, você só não se esforçou o bastante. Ei, lata de sardinha! Aqui é Fruma, né?
Queen's Recruit#192.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#195.src: It really is an impressive construction, isn't it? All this for a closed-off province.
Queen's Recruit#195.dst: É mesmo uma construção impressionante, né? Tudo isso pra uma província fechada.
Queen's Recruit#195.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#196.src: Impressive or not, we have work to do! On your guard, everyone. We don't know what to expect, so watch your backs.
Queen's Recruit#196.dst: Impressionante ou não, temos trabalho a fazer! Atenção, todos. Não sabemos o que esperar, então cuidem das costas.
Queen's Recruit#196.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#197.src: S'anyone's guess when they'll actually let us in...
Queen's Recruit#197.dst: Vai saber quando vão deixar a gente entrar de fato...
Queen's Recruit#197.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#200.src: Soldiers of Wynn! Her Majesty welcomes you to the province, as guests of the crown!
Queen's Recruit#200.dst: Soldados de Wynn! Sua Majestade os recebe na província como convidados da Coroa!
Queen's Recruit#200.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#201.src: Follow me, and you will be escorted to the royal palace. Let's not keep her waiting- you all are of great importance to her.
Queen's Recruit#201.dst: Sigam-me e serão escoltados ao palácio real. Não a deixemos esperando- todos vocês são de grande importância para ela.
Queen's Recruit#201.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#202.src: Listen to the introduction. Go to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to return to the palace.
Queen's Recruit#202.dst: Ouça a apresentação. Vá a [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] para voltar ao palácio.

Queen's Recruit#203.src: Fruma's... a lot bigger than what I saw in my memories...
Queen's Recruit#203.dst: Fruma é... bem maior do que eu via nas minhas memórias...
Queen's Recruit#203.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#204.src: I guess that makes sense. I probably didn't travel much, back then. But... still.
Queen's Recruit#204.dst: Faz sentido, acho. Eu não devia viajar muito, naquela época. Mas... mesmo assim.
Queen's Recruit#204.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#206.src: It... was. I don't know what I expected going in, but... it was stunning.
Queen's Recruit#206.dst: Foi... sim. Não sei o que esperava ao entrar, mas... foi deslumbrante.
Queen's Recruit#206.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#208.src: Ha! Yeah, you know, I think you're right. It was impressive, but Gavel also has impressive sights.
Queen's Recruit#208.dst: Ha! É, sabe, acho que você tem razão. Foi impressionante, mas Gavel também tem belas paisagens.
Queen's Recruit#208.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#209.src: But let's not get distracted. The tour felt very... controlled. We were never let out of the carriages, and the Sovereign was keeping a watchful eye on us.
Queen's Recruit#209.dst: Mas não vamos nos distrair. O passeio pareceu muito... controlado. Nunca nos deixaram sair das carruagens, e o Soberano ficou de olho em nós.
Queen's Recruit#209.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#210.src: I'm interested in what they're choosing not to show us...
Queen's Recruit#210.dst: Me interessa o que eles estão escolhendo não nos mostrar...
Queen's Recruit#210.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#213.src: It is my honor as Queen to facilitate your return to our wonderful province. Though long you have spent away, you will always remain children of Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#213.dst: É uma honra, como Rainha, facilitar seu retorno à nossa maravilhosa província. Por mais tempo que tenham passado longe, sempre serão filhos de Fruma!
Queen's Recruit#213.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#214.src: Your work to battle against the blight beyond our walls has been of great interest. You have certainly made our province proud.
Queen's Recruit#214.dst: Seu trabalho contra a praga além de nossas muralhas nos interessou muito. Vocês certamente orgulharam nossa província.
Queen's Recruit#214.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#215.src: You must have questions on the nature of your summons. All will be revealed- but first, allow me to introduce two of my wonderful Sovereigns.
Queen's Recruit#215.dst: Devem ter perguntas sobre o motivo da convocação. Tudo será revelado- mas antes, permitam-me apresentar dois de meus maravilhosos Soberanos.
Queen's Recruit#215.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#216.src: You heard my name, but let me introduce myself. I am-
Queen's Recruit#216.dst: Ouviram meu nome, mas deixem que me apresente. Eu sou-
Queen's Recruit#216.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#217.src: Majin of House Thalas, the Morning Star, Sovereign of our fair {p}. It's a pleasure, dear soldiers, to join our Queen for this ceremony!
Queen's Recruit#217.dst: Majin da Casa Thalas, a Estrela da Manhã, Soberano da bela {p}. É um prazer, caros soldados, acompanhar nossa Rainha nesta cerimônia!
Queen's Recruit#217.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#218.src: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Sovereign of the {p}. The value of that title should speak for itself.
Queen's Recruit#218.dst: ...Zhiraok Nasin, Soberano de {p}. O valor desse título fala por si.
Queen's Recruit#218.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#219.src: Thank you, Sovereigns. These two, and the rest, are my council for ruling over our province. Each Sovereign is given governance over their own district, and works to serve the people there.
Queen's Recruit#219.dst: Obrigada, Soberanos. Estes dois, e os demais, são meu conselho para governar a província. Cada Soberano governa seu próprio distrito e trabalha para servir o povo de lá.
Queen's Recruit#219.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#220.src: There are others. Though, none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#220.dst: Há outros. Mas nenhum pôde comparecer a este evento - estão ocupados com diversas tarefas.
Queen's Recruit#220.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#221.src: Ah, there we are. Tasim and {u}, you'll be in room W{~}... in the western wing.
Queen's Recruit#221.dst: Ah, aqui está. Tasim e {u}, vocês ficam no quarto W{~}... na ala oeste.
Queen's Recruit#221.speaker: Representative

Queen's Recruit#222.src: 'Cause I'm fast and stealthy. Gotta run now, I don't want to draw the guards' attention. Remember, room W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.dst: Porque sou rápido e furtivo. Tenho que ir, não quero chamar a atenção dos guardas. Lembrem, quarto W{~}!
Queen's Recruit#222.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#223.dst: Novo capítulo iniciado: Volta ao lar

Queen's Recruit#224.src: There are others. Though none could attend this event - they find themselves occupied with various assignments.
Queen's Recruit#224.dst: Há outros. Mas nenhum pôde comparecer a este evento - estão ocupados com diversas tarefas.
Queen's Recruit#224.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#225.src: Enough of the boring talk! It is time for the welcoming feast!
Queen's Recruit#225.dst: Chega de conversa chata! É hora do banquete de boas-vindas!
Queen's Recruit#225.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#226.src: We would like to share a taste of what our province has to deliver. Please find your way to the grand dining hall, situated just behind me.
Queen's Recruit#226.dst: Gostaríamos de compartilhar um gostinho do que nossa província oferece. Por favor, sigam até o grande salão de jantar, logo atrás de mim.
Queen's Recruit#226.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#227.src: Head to the royal dining hall at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#227.dst: Vá ao salão de jantar real em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#228.src: Make your way to the dining hall, the Queen will be starting her speech soon.
Queen's Recruit#228.dst: Sigam até o salão de jantar, a Rainha vai começar o discurso em breve.
Queen's Recruit#228.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#229.src: ...you can't even follow the order of operations while Her Majesty is watching?! What kind of expected value must the recruits ha-
Queen's Recruit#229.dst: ...você não consegue seguir nem a ordem das operações com Sua Majestade olhando?! Que valor esperado os recrutas devem te-
Queen's Recruit#229.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#230.src: Now, now, Nasin, settle down. We wouldn't want to leave a poor impression on our guest, would we?
Queen's Recruit#230.dst: Calma, calma, Nasin, sossegue. Não queremos deixar má impressão no nosso convidado, queremos?
Queen's Recruit#230.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#231.dst: Pare de interromper minha sequência, hipóc-
Queen's Recruit#231.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#232.src: Oh, you. You should report to the dining hall with the remainder of your group.
Queen's Recruit#232.dst: Ah, você. Deveria ir ao salão de jantar com o resto do seu grupo.
Queen's Recruit#232.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Queen's Recruit#233.src: Yes, yes, move along. You certainly don't want to keep Her Majesty waiting!
Queen's Recruit#233.dst: Sim, sim, andando. Você certamente não quer deixar Sua Majestade esperando!
Queen's Recruit#233.speaker: Sovereign Majin

Queen's Recruit#234.src: Well, I have put it off long enough. Before the first course is served, I will reveal the purpose of your presence here today.
Queen's Recruit#234.dst: Bem, já adiei o bastante. Antes que o primeiro prato seja servido, revelarei o propósito da presença de vocês aqui hoje.
Queen's Recruit#234.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#235.src: In celebration of your work in the Wynn Province, we shall be hosting a tournament! You will all partake in a set of duels in order to crown the greatest soldier among you.
Queen's Recruit#235.dst: Em celebração ao trabalho de vocês na província de Wynn, faremos um torneio! Todos participarão de uma série de duelos para coroar o maior soldado entre vocês.
Queen's Recruit#235.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#236.src: You have all grown in your time spent beyond our walls, and what better way to show it?
Queen's Recruit#236.dst: Todos cresceram no tempo além de nossas muralhas, e que maneira melhor de mostrar isso?
Queen's Recruit#236.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#237.src: We will, of course, provide compensation for all participants. A generous monetary reward shall be granted to each of you, no matter your placing in the tournament.
Queen's Recruit#237.dst: Naturalmente, todos os participantes serão recompensados. Cada um receberá uma generosa quantia em dinheiro, seja qual for sua colocação no torneio.
Queen's Recruit#237.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#238.src: However, for whichever of you finds themselves crowned winner... a greater reward awaits. The specifics shall be revealed once the tournament has concluded.
Queen's Recruit#238.dst: Porém, para quem for coroado vencedor... uma recompensa maior aguarda. Os detalhes serão revelados quando o torneio terminar.
Queen's Recruit#238.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#239.src: Ah, your majesty- if I may... I am not much of a fighter - my specialty is in research and study of magic.
Queen's Recruit#239.dst: Ah, Majestade- se me permite... não sou muito de lutar - minha especialidade é a pesquisa e o estudo da magia.
Queen's Recruit#239.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#240.src: ...very well. Accommodations shall be made. A different request may be made of you later, in exchange.
Queen's Recruit#240.dst: ...muito bem. Faremos as devidas adaptações. Em troca, talvez outro pedido lhe seja feito mais tarde.
Queen's Recruit#240.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#241.src: I thank you for your grace and understanding, your majesty.
Queen's Recruit#241.dst: Agradeço sua graça e compreensão, Vossa Majestade.
Queen's Recruit#241.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#242.src: Yes... now. Once the meal comes to a close, you shall all be assigned a room to stay in for the remainder of your stay in my palace.
Queen's Recruit#242.dst: Sim... agora. Quando a refeição terminar, cada um receberá um quarto para o restante da estadia em meu palácio.
Queen's Recruit#242.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#243.src: Ah! It seems the first course has been prepared! Please, enjoy our province's finest cuisine.
Queen's Recruit#243.dst: Ah! Parece que o primeiro prato está pronto! Provem a melhor culinária da nossa província.
Queen's Recruit#243.speaker: Her Majesty

Queen's Recruit#244.src: ...I can't say I was expecting that, of all things.
Queen's Recruit#244.dst: ...não posso dizer que esperava logo isso.
Queen's Recruit#244.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#245.src: You'll be joining the tournament, right?
Queen's Recruit#245.dst: Você vai entrar no torneio, né?
Queen's Recruit#245.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#246.src: We'd better get going and find our rooms- everyone else headed south.
Queen's Recruit#246.dst: Melhor irmos achar nossos quartos- todo mundo foi pro sul.
Queen's Recruit#246.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#247.src: Get your assigned room from the representative at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#247.dst: Pegue seu quarto com o representante em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#249.src: Your rooms are located on the east and west side of here.
Queen's Recruit#249.dst: Seus quartos ficam a leste e a oeste daqui.
Queen's Recruit#249.speaker: Aelumia Guard

Queen's Recruit#250.src: Your rooms are on the other side of the castle. Please make your way over there.
Queen's Recruit#250.dst: Seus quartos ficam do outro lado do castelo. Sigam até lá, por favor.
Queen's Recruit#250.speaker: Gendarme Soldier

Queen's Recruit#254.dst: ...este é {u} e eu sou o Tasim.
Queen's Recruit#254.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#255.src: Talk about a fancy feast, huh?
Queen's Recruit#255.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#256.src: They're really pullin' out all the stops, huh? Don't think I've had anythin' that good in a long while.
Queen's Recruit#256.dst: Eles tão caprichando mesmo, hein? Acho que faz tempo que não como nada tão bom.
Queen's Recruit#256.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#257.src: Yeah, that was probably the best meal I've had in a long time... Really tired me out. Can't wait for a long and good rest.
Queen's Recruit#257.dst: É, deve ter sido a melhor refeição que tive em muito tempo... Me deixou exausto. Mal posso esperar por um bom descanso.
Queen's Recruit#257.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#258.src: How 'bout us? I'm Mel, and this is Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.dst: E a gente? Eu sou a Mel, e este é o Linton.
Queen's Recruit#258.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#260.src: Uh- hey, I think you forgot someone! Where am I staying?
Queen's Recruit#260.dst: Hã- ei, acho que você esqueceu alguém! Onde eu vou ficar?
Queen's Recruit#260.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#263.src: Oh... uh, Kymer, huh? That's... hm. Okay.
Queen's Recruit#263.dst: Ah... hã, com o Kymer, é? Isso é... hm. Tá.
Queen's Recruit#263.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#265.src: Head to your room, W-{~}, and check it out.
Queen's Recruit#265.dst: Vá ao seu quarto, W-{~}, e dê uma olhada.

Queen's Recruit#266.src: I'm just gonna wait here for Lanu.
Queen's Recruit#266.dst: Vou só esperar a Lanu aqui.
Queen's Recruit#266.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#267.src: Hm... {u}? Think you've got the wrong room!
Queen's Recruit#267.dst: Hm... {u}? Acho que você errou de quarto!
Queen's Recruit#267.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#268.src: Odd that I've got a room all to myself... but eh, I won't complain.
Queen's Recruit#268.dst: Estranho eu ter um quarto só pra mim... mas, ah, não vou reclamar.
Queen's Recruit#268.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#269.src: Kymer. Sure! Cool, cool cool cool... I can stay with the... big biceps... yep. That's... fine. That's fine. Good, even.
Queen's Recruit#269.dst: Kymer. Claro! Beleza, beleza beleza beleza... Posso ficar com os... bíceps... é. Isso é... de boa. De boa. Ótimo, até.
Queen's Recruit#269.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#271.src: It seems cozy enough, I guess... hard to relax, though, given... you know. all of it.
Queen's Recruit#271.dst: Parece bem aconchegante, acho... mas difícil relaxar, dado... sabe. tudo isso.
Queen's Recruit#271.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#272.src: ...it's easier than I thought it would be, being in Fruma. There's enough distance from... the, uh, memories.
Queen's Recruit#272.dst: ...estar em Fruma é mais fácil do que eu pensava. Há distância suficiente das... hã, memórias.
Queen's Recruit#272.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#273.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So... what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited just for this?
Queen's Recruit#273.dst: Mas, tá, agora estamos a sós. Então... o que você acha mesmo do torneio? É estranho, né? Por que nos convidariam só pra isso?
Queen's Recruit#273.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#274.src: Me neither. I don't know what I was expecting when we were entering Fruma, but it wasn't... this.
Queen's Recruit#274.dst: Nem eu. Não sei o que esperava ao entrar em Fruma, mas não era... isto.
Queen's Recruit#274.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#275.src: I think we'll have to participate, but keep an eye out. Maybe the secret reward will have some answers..
Queen's Recruit#275.dst: Acho que vamos ter que participar, mas de olhos abertos. Talvez a recompensa secreta traga respostas..
Queen's Recruit#275.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#276.src: Hm... you're probably right, I just don't know what it could possibly be.
Queen's Recruit#276.dst: Hm... você deve ter razão, só não sei o que poderia ser.
Queen's Recruit#276.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#277.src: Maybe there's something going on with that secret reward for the winner... we'll have to wait and see, I guess.
Queen's Recruit#277.dst: Talvez haja algo por trás daquela recompensa secreta pro vencedor... vamos ter que esperar pra ver, acho.
Queen's Recruit#277.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#278.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I'm a little excited, too. I haven't had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it'll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#278.dst: Ha! É, tá bom. Também estou meio empolgado. Faz tempo que não tenho duelos amistosos, então talvez seja bom testar minha força.
Queen's Recruit#278.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#279.src: But don’t forget why we’re here. Keep your guard up. Something about that reward she mentioned... it makes me uneasy.
Queen's Recruit#279.dst: Mas não esqueça por que estamos aqui. Fique atento. Algo naquela recompensa que ela mencionou... me deixa inquieto.
Queen's Recruit#279.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#280.src: It strikes me as the kind of thing Aledar would enjoy. What better way to prove himself than to win this big tournament?
Queen's Recruit#280.dst: Parece o tipo de coisa que o Aledar curtiria. Que jeito melhor de provar seu valor do que vencer esse grande torneio?
Queen's Recruit#280.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#281.src: He'd get to use all his potions and tricks, too! He's always telling me about the horrific creations he's mixed together.
Queen's Recruit#281.dst: Ele poderia usar todas as poções e truques dele também! Vive me contando das criações horríveis que já misturou.
Queen's Recruit#281.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#283.src: But, okay, we're in private now. So.. what do you actually think of the tournament? It's weird, right? Why would we be invited for this?
Queen's Recruit#283.dst: Mas, tá, agora estamos a sós. Então.. o que você acha mesmo do torneio? É estranho, né? Por que nos convidariam pra isso?
Queen's Recruit#283.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#284.src: Ha! Yeah, alright. I’m a little excited, too. I haven’t had any friendly duels for a long time, so maybe it’ll be nice to test my strength.
Queen's Recruit#284.dst: Ha! É, tá bom. Também estou meio empolgado. Faz tempo que não tenho duelos amistosos, então talvez seja bom testar minha força.
Queen's Recruit#284.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#288.src: Oh, uh, nothing much. Just a secret meeting. In Jenprest's room- that's W{~}, at the start of the corridor.
Queen's Recruit#288.dst: Ah, hã, nada demais. Só uma reunião secreta. No quarto do Jenprest- é o W{~}, no começo do corredor.
Queen's Recruit#288.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#289.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#289.dst: O Picard diz que devemos conversar sobre o que temos até agora. Também disse pra espaçar quem vai pro quarto, então esperem uns minutos antes de vir!
Queen's Recruit#289.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#290.src: Picard says we should talk about what we've got so far. He also said to space out people coming to the room- so wait a few minutes before stopping by!
Queen's Recruit#290.dst: O Picard diz que devemos conversar sobre o que temos até agora. Também disse pra espaçar quem vai pro quarto- então esperem uns minutos antes de vir!
Queen's Recruit#290.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#291.src: I... guess that makes sense. But why are you here, and not-
Queen's Recruit#291.dst: Eu... acho que faz sentido. Mas por que você está aqui, e não-
Queen's Recruit#291.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#292.src: ...he's energetic, huh. Okay, let's head over to the meeting. I wonder what the others have noticed.
Queen's Recruit#292.dst: ...ele é cheio de energia, hein. Tá, vamos à reunião. Será que os outros notaram algo?
Queen's Recruit#292.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#293.src: Meet up with the others in room W-{~} at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].
Queen's Recruit#293.dst: Encontre os outros no quarto W-{~} em [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Queen's Recruit#294.src: Ah, good, they're here. Come in, come in. Quickly now.
Queen's Recruit#294.dst: Ah, ótimo, chegaram. Entrem, entrem. Rápido.
Queen's Recruit#294.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#295.src: Are we the last ones in?
Queen's Recruit#295.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#296.src: That y'are. Now, Picard, mind tellin' me what was on your damned mind when you commandeered my room without sayin' a word ?!
Queen's Recruit#296.dst: São, sim. Agora, Picard, se importa de me dizer o que diabos passou pela sua cabeça quando tomou meu quarto sem dizer nada ?!
Queen's Recruit#296.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#297.src: Ah, eheh, well- I suppose it, er, may have slipped the mind... not important! We're under a time constraint!
Queen's Recruit#297.dst: Ah, eheh, bem- suponho que isso, hã, possa ter me escapado... não importa! Estamos com o tempo contado!
Queen's Recruit#297.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#298.src: We've made it this far, but we'll need to plan our next steps. Firstly, however- let us start with what information we have gleaned thus far.
Queen's Recruit#298.dst: Chegamos até aqui, mas precisamos planejar os próximos passos. Primeiro, porém- comecemos pelas informações que reunimos até agora.
Queen's Recruit#298.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#299.src: Well, the crown certainly has money to spare! What we've seen thus far seems to rival even the richest of the nobility I had the pleasure of working with in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#299.dst: Bem, a coroa certamente tem dinheiro de sobra! O que vimos até agora parece rivalizar até com a nobreza mais rica com quem tive o prazer de trabalhar em {p}.
Queen's Recruit#299.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#300.src: And the architectural style... it's unique. I haven't seen anything like it before. I suppose it would make sense, if the province has been closed off so long...
Queen's Recruit#300.dst: E o estilo arquitetônico... é único. Nunca vi nada parecido. Acho que faria sentido, se a província está fechada há tanto tempo...
Queen's Recruit#300.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#301.src: Eh, enough of the unimportant details - any of the rest o' you feelin' strange about the tournament? Seems an odd thing to invite us folks back for.
Queen's Recruit#301.dst: Ah, chega de detalhe sem importância - mais alguém aqui achando o torneio estranho? Motivo esquisito pra chamar a gente de volta.
Queen's Recruit#301.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#302.src: I was thinking the same thing. And they're willing to pay all of us for participating, no matter how we do... I don't get why.
Queen's Recruit#302.dst: Eu estava pensando o mesmo. E estão dispostos a pagar todos nós por participar, não importa o resultado... não entendo por quê.
Queen's Recruit#302.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#303.src: Hm, well, in truth I am not overly concerned about it-
Queen's Recruit#303.dst: Hm, bem, na verdade não estou tão preocupado com isso-
Queen's Recruit#303.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#304.src: Yes, actually, Picard, what was that back there in the dining hall? You're going to draw attention to yourself by opting out of it?
Queen's Recruit#304.dst: Pois é, aliás, Picard, o que foi aquilo no salão de jantar? Vai chamar atenção pra si mesmo se retirando do torneio?
Queen's Recruit#304.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#305.src: Oh, what use is there in placing me in such a combat scenario?! I'll be far more useful outside of that structure, free to look around the palace.
Queen's Recruit#305.dst: Ora, de que adianta me colocar num cenário de combate desses?! Serei bem mais útil fora daquela estrutura, livre para explorar o palácio.
Queen's Recruit#305.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#306.src: And besides, they have me giving them a summary of my research notes, so it's not as though I'm free of it entirely, not to mention-
Queen's Recruit#306.dst: E além disso, eles me pediram um resumo das minhas notas de pesquisa, então não estou totalmente livre, sem falar que-
Queen's Recruit#306.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#307.src: Alright, settle down y'all! Limited time, remember? We've gone off track. They're rich, fancy, and want us fightin' for some reason. What else?
Queen's Recruit#307.dst: Tá, sosseguem todos! Tempo limitado, lembram? A gente se desviou. Eles são ricos, chiques e querem a gente brigando por algum motivo. Que mais?
Queen's Recruit#307.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#308.src: ...as I was saying before I was rudely interrupted- I don't believe there is much to be gleaned from the tournament just yet. It's a puzzle piece we'll have to connect later.
Queen's Recruit#308.dst: ...como eu dizia antes de ser rudemente interrompido- não creio que haja muito a tirar do torneio ainda. É uma peça do quebra-cabeça que vamos encaixar depois.
Queen's Recruit#308.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#309.src: Do we have anything on the Queen and her Sovereigns? It's an interesting governmental structure, but I suppose having a more direct line to the Queen has value for the districts.
Queen's Recruit#309.dst: Temos algo sobre a Rainha e seus Soberanos? É uma estrutura de governo interessante, mas suponho que ter uma linha direta com a Rainha tenha valor pros distritos.
Queen's Recruit#309.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#310.src: Well, they're obviously putting on an act. They're definitely hiding something from us, and I don't think any of them are as happy to see us as they say they are.
Queen's Recruit#310.dst: Bom, é óbvio que estão encenando. Com certeza estão escondendo algo, e não acho que nenhum deles esteja tão feliz em nos ver quanto diz.
Queen's Recruit#310.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#311.src: Yes, indeed... we were sent into Wynn as exiles, not as honored soldiers. So why are they pretending otherwise? They called us back here.
Queen's Recruit#311.dst: Sim, de fato... fomos mandados a Wynn como exilados, não como soldados honrados. Por que fingem o contrário? Eles nos chamaram de volta.
Queen's Recruit#311.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#312.src: Ah! Perhaps they're unaware that we've cracked that memory spell? For all they know, we still believe their lies.
Queen's Recruit#312.dst: Ah! Talvez não saibam que quebramos aquele feitiço de memória? Pelo que sabem, ainda acreditamos nas mentiras deles.
Queen's Recruit#312.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#313.src: It'd explain some things, for certain...
Queen's Recruit#313.dst: Isso explicaria umas coisas, com certeza...
Queen's Recruit#313.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#314.src: So, am I the only one confused by the amount of guards around?
Queen's Recruit#314.dst: Então, sou o único confuso com a quantidade de guardas por aí?
Queen's Recruit#314.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#315.src: You'd think that nine strangers entering the royal palace would be under more watchful eyes.
Queen's Recruit#315.dst: Era de se esperar que nove estranhos no palácio real fossem mais vigiados.
Queen's Recruit#315.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#316.src: Now that you mention it... the only guards I saw on the way to our rooms were by the courtyard exit. There aren't any outside our rooms.
Queen's Recruit#316.dst: Agora que você falou... os únicos guardas que vi a caminho dos quartos estavam na saída do pátio. Não há nenhum fora dos quartos.
Queen's Recruit#316.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#317.src: ...so we don't need to do the whole stealthy thing?
Queen's Recruit#317.dst: ...então não precisamos daquela coisa de furtividade?
Queen's Recruit#317.speaker: Linton

Queen's Recruit#319.src: Seems likely to me they want us t' feel safe and trusted. They've got to know we'll be talkin' about everything we see, so why not leave a good impression, eh?
Queen's Recruit#319.dst: Pra mim, eles querem que a gente se sinta seguro e confiável. Devem saber que vamos falar de tudo que virmos, então por que não deixar boa impressão, né?
Queen's Recruit#319.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#320.src: A strong spell should get through this wood without a problem.
Queen's Recruit#320.dst: Um feitiço forte atravessaria esta madeira sem problema.

Queen's Recruit#321.src: Besides, they've got those two Sovereigns lookin' over us. Pretty strong, aren't they? Figure that's enough incentive not to cause trouble.
Queen's Recruit#321.dst: Além disso, eles têm aqueles dois Soberanos de olho na gente. Bem fortes, né? Acho que é motivo suficiente pra não arrumar encrenca.
Queen's Recruit#321.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#322.src: Speakin' of the Sovereigns... and the guards, by extension - anyone else adept at readin' mana? It hardly feels like there's any of it in use at all!
Queen's Recruit#322.dst: Falando dos Soberanos... e dos guardas, por tabela - mais alguém aqui sabe ler mana? Parece que quase ninguém usa nada dela!
Queen's Recruit#322.speaker: Mel

Queen's Recruit#323.src: I was going to bring that up. I haven't seen any mages at all. The closest I've seen is the higher ranked soldiers wielding magical weapons.
Queen's Recruit#323.dst: Eu ia comentar isso. Não vi nenhum mago. O mais perto disso são os soldados de patente alta empunhando armas mágicas.
Queen's Recruit#323.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#324.src: I'm not as good with reading mana, but... there's something with the Sovereigns. They've got an incredibly powerful aura surrounding them. It feels... unnatural.
Queen's Recruit#324.dst: Não sou tão bom em ler mana, mas... há algo nos Soberanos. Eles têm uma aura incrivelmente poderosa em volta. Parece... antinatural.
Queen's Recruit#324.speaker: Tasim

Queen's Recruit#325.src: Yes, you're right. They, and the Queen, are the only ones I've seen here who possess innate magical abilities. If anything, all three of them seem closely linked in terms of energy...
Queen's Recruit#325.dst: Sim, tem razão. Eles e a Rainha são os únicos que vi aqui com habilidades mágicas inatas. Aliás, os três parecem muito ligados em termos de energia...
Queen's Recruit#325.speaker: Lanu

Queen's Recruit#326.src: As interesting as that is, it doesn't leave much for the rest of us to go off of. Doctor, you're the one who organized us here. What are our plans?
Queen's Recruit#326.dst: Por mais interessante que seja, não deixa muito pro resto de nós seguir. Doutor, foi o senhor que nos reuniu aqui. Quais são os planos?
Queen's Recruit#326.speaker: Reynauld

Queen's Recruit#327.src: Yes, that I am... well, it seems our most promising lead is the Sovereigns. We'll want to focus on them- though, do not neglect general information. We still want to know as much about Fruma as possible.
Queen's Recruit#327.dst: Sim, fui eu... bem, parece que nossa pista mais promissora são os Soberanos. Vamos focar neles- mas não descuidem das informações gerais. Ainda queremos saber o máximo possível sobre Fruma.
Queen's Recruit#327.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#328.src: We've been running long enough, let's call it a day. Everyone, get some rest, we must be at our best performance tomorrow.
Queen's Recruit#328.dst: Já nos estendemos demais, vamos encerrar por hoje. Descansem todos, precisamos estar no nosso melhor amanhã.
Queen's Recruit#328.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#329.src: Let us gather here again tomorrow evening for another meeting. Goodnight, everyone.
Queen's Recruit#329.dst: Vamos nos reunir aqui de novo amanhã à noite para outra reunião. Boa noite a todos.
Queen's Recruit#329.speaker: Dr. Picard

Queen's Recruit#330.src: Make your way back to W-{~} and sleep.

Queen's Recruit#331.src: Those Sovereigns... they do concern me. If Fruma's leadership holds this much power, then...
Queen's Recruit#331.dst: Aqueles Soberanos... me preocupam, sim. Se os líderes de Fruma têm tanto poder, então...
Queen's Recruit#331.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#332.src: Hm. Perhaps our King is right not to get on their bad side.
Queen's Recruit#332.dst: Hm. Talvez nosso Rei esteja certo em não ficar contra eles.
Queen's Recruit#332.speaker: Captain Kymer

Queen's Recruit#333.src: Ah, great, now all o' you are lingerin'. Get out of my room! Not gonna get a lick o' sleep till you're gone...
Queen's Recruit#333.dst: Ah, ótimo, agora cês tão tudo enrolando aqui. Saiam do meu quarto! Não vou pregar o olho até cês saírem...
Queen's Recruit#333.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#334.src: ...damned Doctor- should'a just used his own room!!
Queen's Recruit#334.dst: ...maldito Doutor- devia ter usado o próprio quarto!!
Queen's Recruit#334.speaker: Jenprest

Queen's Recruit#335.src: ...sigh. What am I doing here? I should have stayed back in {p}.
Queen's Recruit#335.dst: ...ai. O que estou fazendo aqui? Devia ter ficado em {p}.
Queen's Recruit#335.speaker: Reynauld
